head: 1c2acfc34b611f6b4f957faebf263c820b0ac6cb
claim: The CI receipt gate no longer asks for product proof on a change that touches only dependency manifests or workflow files, while product source, tests, scripts, tsconfig and packages/ changes still need one

target.version: scripts/ci-changes.ts at the pull request head

steps.start: an empty git repository holding the committed scripts/ci-changes.ts and one base commit
steps: Commit a change (dependency bump: package.json, package-lock.json, example manifest) and run node scripts/ci-changes.ts against the base
Commit a change (workflow bump: .github/workflows/ci.yml, .github/dependabot.yml) and run node scripts/ci-changes.ts against the base
Commit a change (product source: packages/pair/src/index.ts) and run node scripts/ci-changes.ts against the base
Commit a change (kit manifest: packages/pair/package.json) and run node scripts/ci-changes.ts against the base
Commit a change (script: scripts/test.sh) and run node scripts/ci-changes.ts against the base
Commit a change (dependency bump plus a test file) and run node scripts/ci-changes.ts against the base
Commit a change (android: android/build.gradle) and run node scripts/ci-changes.ts against the base
Commit a change (tsconfig.base.json) and run node scripts/ci-changes.ts against the base
Commit a change (docs only: docs/a.md) and run node scripts/ci-changes.ts against the base
steps.result: every case matched: dependency-only and workflow-only diffs need no receipt; all product changes still do

verdicts.seen: Read 9 entries. Dependency-only (package.json, package-lock.json, example manifest) shows receipt=false (want false); workflow-only (.github/workflows/ci.yml, dependabot.yml) shows receipt=false (want false). Product source (packages/pair/src/index.ts), kit manifest, scripts/test.sh, dependency bump plus test file, android, tsconfig.base.json all show receipt=true (want true). Docs-only is false (want false). All lines are ok and match the outcome.
